description: This Java source file implements the OrderSetService for the OpenMRS project, providing methods to manage OrderSet entities, including creating, retiring, unretiring, and retrieving order sets and related attribute types.

classes.name: OrderSetServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the OrderSetService interface, managing persistence and lifecycle of OrderSet entities within the OpenMRS API framework.

methods.name: setOrderSetDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO (Data Access Object) used to interact with the database for OrderSet entities.

methods.name: saveOrderSet
methods.description: Saves a new or existing OrderSet entity to the database.

methods.name: retireOrderSet
methods.description: Retires an OrderSet, marking it as no longer active and adding a retire reason.

methods.name: saveOrderSetInternal
methods.description: Internal method that handles the actual saving logic for OrderSet, updating attributes and handling retired members.

methods.name: getOrderSets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderSets, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OrderSet by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSet by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetMember by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Gets an OrderSetAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Gets an OrderSetAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: retireOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retires an OrderSetAttributeType, presumably marking it as inactive.

methods.name: purgeOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderSetAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its name.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Gets an OrderSetAttribute by its UUID.
